verdict.rationale: Raygun hosts Swagger UI over its published OpenAPI 3.0.3 v3 spec (46 paths). All submit methods are enabled, so each operation has a working "Try it out" runner, which makes it an interactive reference with runnable requests. The 404s on raygun.com/openapi.json do not contradict this, because the spec is served from the api.raygun.com origin. Missing for 10: a sandbox or mock environment (the runner executes against the production API with a Personal Access Token), documented multi-language code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Raygun hosts Swagger UI over its spec at https://api.raygun.com/v3/swagger/index.html; the served configuration loads the v3 spec and enables all submit methods, so the per-operation "Try it out" runner is available
Raygun publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document ("Raygun API", 46 paths, servers https://api.raygun.com/v3) at the API origin
